patterns.name: Technical specifications
patterns.notes: Use structured rows and groups. Never parse product descriptions or tags into specifications.

patterns.name: Trust and support
patterns.notes: Do not hardcode warranty durations, freight estimates, contact details, or entity roles.

patterns.name: Compatibility
patterns.notes: Tags, title similarity, dimensions, and family resemblance are not compatibility evidence.

patterns.name: Technical diagram
patterns.notes: A complex diagram requires an adjacent text explanation or structured list.

patterns.name: Instructional video
patterns.notes: No autoplay and no third-party player request before deliberate activation.

patterns.name: Educational content
patterns.notes: Use an existing Trade rich-text or article section when it satisfies the content and accessibility requirements.

patterns.name: Product comparison
patterns.notes: D-PBI-017 intentionally omits the homepage teaser until Epic I or approved buying guidance provides a truthful destination. Do not implement until machine identity, supported operations, dimensions or footprint, electrical requirements, approved motor or speed data, verified machine weight, included components, applicable consumables or accessories, and other compared fields are structured, approved, and conflict-resolved.

patterns.name: Homepage hero
patterns.notes: Homepage-only first-screen relationship. Owns the semantic page h1 and pairs approved copy, governed Shopify Files media, and approved CTA routes without embedding text in imagery.

patterns.name: Homepage link group
patterns.notes: Homepage-only lightweight link-group pattern. Approved because the equivalent Trade multicolumn and rich-text composition adds three stylesheet requests against the governed homepage request budget. Does not imply compatibility or technical capability.
